connect-protocol-version.description: Define the version of the Connect protocol
connect-protocol-version.title: Connect-Protocol-Version

code.description: The status code, which should be an enum value of [google.rpc.Code][google.rpc.Code].

details.description: A list of messages that carry the error details. There is no limit on the number of messages.

message.description: A developer-facing error message, which should be in English. Any user-facing error message should be localized and sent in the [google.rpc.Status.details][google.rpc.Status.details] field, or localized by the client.

connect.error_details.Any.description: Contains an arbitrary serialized message along with a @type that describes the type of the serialized message, with an additional debug field for ConnectRPC error details.

debug.description: Deserialized error detail payload. The 'type' field indicates the schema. This field is for easier debugging and should not be relied upon for application logic.
debug.title: Debug

type.description: A URL that acts as a globally unique identifier for the type of the serialized message. For example: `type.googleapis.com/google.rpc.ErrorInfo`.

value.description: The Protobuf message, serialized as bytes and base64-encoded. The specific message type is identified by the `type` field.

confirmSelfRemoval.description: One-shot confirmation; requires a verified active Owner in replacement roles.
confirmSelfRemoval.title: confirm_self_removal

funnel.v1.BootstrapCredentials.description: Bootstrap credentials must not be persisted in plans, logs or receipts.
funnel.v1.BootstrapCredentials.title: BootstrapCredentials

kubernetesErrors.description: Per-resource reconciliation failures; unrelated hosts remain operational.
kubernetesErrors.title: kubernetes_errors

funnel.v1.DatabaseConfiguration.description: Control database settings contain file paths or Secret references, never credentials.
funnel.v1.DatabaseConfiguration.title: DatabaseConfiguration

dryRun.description: Preview-only bundles are rejected by hidden installers.
dryRun.title: dry_run

placementJson.description: Resolved placement, carried to the executor without local file references.
placementJson.title: placement_json

funnel.v1.DockerInventoryPayload.description: Only complete, successfully parsed scans may retire registrations.
funnel.v1.DockerInventoryPayload.title: DockerInventoryPayload

funnel.v1.Permission.description: Permission is checked against verified transport identity, never client metadata.
funnel.v1.Permission.title: Permission

funnel.v1.ShutdownRequest.description: Shutdown first withdraws owned state; confirm acknowledges receipt before device deletion.
funnel.v1.ShutdownRequest.title: ShutdownRequest
